//: Profile registry. One entry per plugin in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. Read by lib/profiles.py.
//tested_claude_code: The Claude Code version this release's live proof ran on. The README's prerequisites line names the same version.

core.summary: Safety guards, integrity checks and onboarding.

continuity.summary: Session continuity: handover, wrap-up and the memory and CLAUDE.md distillers.

builder.summary: The /build workflow and its executor and reviewer agents.
features: Workflow tool (optional; falls back to one Agent dispatch)

//writers: One key per hook executable in any plugin's hooks/hooks.json. The value says what the hook writes, moves or deletes on its own, or is exactly "nothing". A missing or extra key fails tools/catalogue/tests.

writers.tools/hook-heartbeat/claude-hook-heartbe: its own marker files under ~/.claude/claude-code-toolkit/heartbeat/, pruned after 30 days
writers.tools/toolkit-integrity/claude-toolkit-i: its own state in ~/.claude/toolkit-integrity-state.json, and the hook-fires audit's verdict cache in ~/.claude/claude-code-toolkit/heartbeat-audit.json, and the tool-rules audit's verdict cache in ~/.claude/claude-code-toolkit/tool-rules-audit.json
writers.tools/repo-freshness/claude-repo-freshne: runs a background git fetch in each watched repo, updating its remote-tracking refs; with repo_freshness.sync on (off by default) it also fast-forwards clean repos with git pull and clones missing ones; its own throttle stamp in ~/.cache/claude-repo-sync.stamp
writers.tools/usage-watch/claude-usage-dispatch: nothing; it reads the budget cache and ~/.claude/usage-anchors.json, only with usage_watch.dispatch_advisory on (off by default)
writers.tools/session-titler/claude-title-sessio: appends a title line to the ended session's transcript; its own index in ~/.claude/session-index.tsv and log in ~/.claude/title-hook.log
writers.tools/thread-handover/claude-thread-watc: marks a pending handover consumed in ~/.claude/thread-handover/index.json when a prompt in this session names its file, which stops it being offered again and starts its archive clock; its own state under ~/.claude/thread-handover/sessions/
writers.tools/usage-watch/claude-usage-watch: its own state in ~/.claude/usage-budget-state.json, plus ~/.claude/usage-anchors.json with usage_watch.estimate on (off by default)
writers.tools/thread-handover/claude-thread-deli: moves consumed handover files into <handover_dir>/archive/handovers/ once both grace gates clear; its own index under ~/.claude/thread-handover/
writers.tools/context-budget/claude-context-budg: its own readings log in ~/.claude/context-budget/readings.jsonl, one line a day
writers.tools/usage-watch/claude-usage-postmorte: writes a handover document into <handover_dir> when a turn dies on a usage limit, and registers it under ~/.claude/thread-handover/
writers.tools/session-claim/claude-session-claim: when a second session writes into a checkout another live session holds, creates a git worktree and claim/ branch under that checkout's .claude/worktrees/ and adds that path to its .git/info/exclude; its own state under ~/.claude/session-claims/
writers.tools/session-claim/claude-session-relea: its own state under ~/.claude/session-claims/; it does not remove the worktrees session-claim created
writers.tools/build-cost/claude-build-cost-recor: appends a row for each qualifying session to ~/.claude/build-costs.jsonl, and another superseding row when a resumed session has grown
writers.tools/base-pin/claude-base-pin: runs a background git fetch in the current repo, updating its remote-tracking refs; its own state in ~/.claude/base-pin-state.json
writers.tools/spec-archive/claude-spec-archive: moves shipped specs from spec_archive.specs_dir into its archive/ folder; with spec_archive.stale_flip_days set (off by default) it also rewrites idle specs' status: live to shipped; a lock file in specs_dir
writers.tools/harness-check/claude-harness-check: its own state in ~/.claude/harness-check-noticed.json, only with harness_check.enabled on (off by default)
writers.tools/caffeinate/claude-caffeinate: starts and stops macOS caffeinate processes that keep the Mac awake, only with caffeinate.enabled on (off by default); its own state under ~/.claude/caffeinate/
